description: The plot illustrates how “Similarity” varies across model “Layer” for four language-pair conditions shown as separate lines. The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer layers from 0 to 23 with tick labels shown every 2 layers (0, 2, 4, …, 22). The y-axis is labeled “Similarity,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.00 up to 0.45 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.05 intervals. Four solid lines without markers are shown: the dark red line labeled “en&en” starts near 0.07 at layer 0, rises to about 0.26 around layer 6, drops to about 0.16 at layer 7, stays around 0.15–0.18 through roughly layers 9–13, declines to about 0.08–0.10 around layers 18–21, then increases sharply to about 0.18 at layer 22 and about 0.43 at layer 23. The blue line labeled “en&es” starts near 0.06 at layer 0, increases to about 0.24 at layer 6, drops to about 0.15 at layer 7, remains around 0.15–0.18 through about layers 9–13, decreases to roughly 0.06–0.08 by layers 18–21, then rises to about 0.12 at layer 22 and about 0.27 at layer 23. The green line labeled “en&el” begins near 0.045 at layer 0, climbs to about 0.15 at layer 6, drops to about 0.10 at layer 7, increases gradually to around 0.14–0.15 by about layers 12–13, declines to about 0.05 by around layers 19–21, then rises to about 0.12 at layer 22 and about 0.30 at layer 23. The pink line labeled “en&bn” starts near 0.035 at layer 0, rises to about 0.14 at layer 6, drops to about 0.095 at layer 7, increases to around 0.13–0.14 by about layers 12–13, decreases to about 0.055 by around layers 18–20, then increases to about 0.14 at layer 22 and about 0.29 at layer 23.
